items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Clint Smith. And Biscuit; I think Biscuit was in there, a trumpet player.

ctx.x: Clint Smith. And Biscuit; I think Biscuit was in there, a trumpet player. A boy called Biscuit. He was a good trumpet player. Read good and everything.
And the rhythm section was Ray on piano...
